indicators.title: FOMC rate decision
indicators.why: The single most-watched policy event on the calendar: market-implied probability of each decision bucket (cut, hold, hike) at the next scheduled FOMC meeting, from the exchange's highest-volume Fed series.
indicators.source: Kalshi public API v2 — series KXFEDDECISION
indicators.note: Buckets are mutually exclusive and use Kalshi's own wording; "Hike 0bps" means no change to the target range. If the meeting is canceled, the hold bucket resolves Yes.

measures.quantity: the size and direction of the change in the federal funds target range at the next scheduled FOMC meeting, in basis points — five mutually exclusive buckets (Cut >25bps, Cut 25bps, Hike 0bps, Hike 25bps, Hike >25bps)
measures.source_release: U.S. Federal Reserve — the FOMC statement (settlement source: federalreserve.gov)
measures.resolution: settles within minutes of the meeting statement on meeting day; a canceled meeting resolves the hold bucket to Yes — expected 2026-10-28
measures.text: the size and direction of the change in the federal funds target range at the next scheduled FOMC meeting, in basis points — five mutually exclusive buckets (Cut >25bps, Cut 25bps, Hike 0bps, Hike 25bps, Hike >25bps) Reference: October 28, 2026. Source: U.S. Federal Reserve — the FOMC statement (settlement source: federalreserve.gov). Resolution: settles within minutes of the meeting statement on meeting day; a canceled meeting resolves the hold bucket to Yes — expected 2026-10-28.

indicators.paper: The paper finds the mode and median of the Kalshi distribution perfectly matched the realized federal funds rate on the day before every FOMC meeting since 2022 — a statistically significant improvement over fed funds futures (MAE 0.000 vs 0.010, RMSE 0.000 vs 0.020, p<0.05).
indicators.track_record_note: Day-before mode matched the realized decision in 1/1 past meetings in the archive. Realized decisions are public record (FOMC statements).

fomc_fan.level_note: Levels are the UPPER BOUND of the federal funds target range — the quantity the exchange's own funds-rate markets settle on (not the midpoint). Each decision bucket is translated using the prevailing pre-meeting target range (recorded per meeting from the daily target-range series, never a single hardcoded base); 'Hike >25bps' and 'Cut >25bps' map to ±0.50, the smallest move in each family, and are labeled as such.
fomc_fan.note: Post-meeting target-range upper bound implied by the decision buckets, with the pre-meeting base 4.00% recorded per meeting.
fomc_fan.track_note: Post-meeting rate fell inside the day-before 50% interval in 1/1 resolved meetings in the archive.

accuracy.convention: Prediction: the mode decision bucket (highest-probability outcome) at the last close strictly before the meeting day (the statement lands mid-session at 2:00 PM ET, so the meeting-day close is post-information). Scored hit/miss vs the realized decision and by the multiclass Brier score across the five buckets, using the renormalized day-before prices.

rows.note: Prediction frozen at first record (append-only; the daily run never recomputes history). Actual from the realized dataset (prints frozen at first observation) or the public-record FOMC decisions table. Realized decision: public record (FOMC statement), recorded per meeting in the realized-decisions table.

indicators.title: Fed funds rate level
indicators.why: The market's full policy-rate distribution: threshold probabilities for the funds-rate setting after the next FOMC meeting, complementing the decision buckets with the level the market actually prices.
indicators.source: Kalshi public API v2 — series KXFED
indicators.note: Each strike is the probability that the UPPER BOUND of the target range is strictly above that level following the meeting; strikes are cumulative, not mutually exclusive.

measures.source_release: Federal Reserve Board of Governors — the target range published on the Fed's official website

indicators.paper: The paper recommends Kalshi as the source for risk-neutral probability densities of FOMC decisions at specific meetings: fed funds futures force a two-outcome assumption, and SOFR options are too far removed (basis and horizon mismatch).

distribution.note: Implied distributions are recovered from each day's strike ladder following Diercks/Katz/Wright (2026), FEDS 2026-010, Section 3: bin probabilities by strike differencing with mode-outward monotonicity. These are risk-neutral (Q-measure) probabilities, not physical ones; thin tail contracts can be stale.

The exchange sometimes lists a MoM market without the matching YoY market for a given print; those gaps are marked, never interpolated. No market was listed for the October 2026 print as of 2026-10-25 — the nearest listed market closes 2026-12-10. Gaps are marked, not interpolated.

indicators.title: NBER recession
indicators.why: The clearest market summary of macro tail risk: the probability that a recession is underway within each covered window, on the technical-recession rule the contracts actually settle on.
indicators.source: Kalshi public API v2 — series KXRECSSNBER
indicators.note: Annual ladder: every open calendar-year market is charted. Despite the series ticker, the listed rules settle on BEA data — two consecutive quarters of negative real GDP growth within the covered window (2025 or 2026 for the 2026 market; Q4 2026 through Q4 2027 for the 2027 market) — NOT on NBER Business Cycle Dating Committee calls. Trading runs to the morning of the expected Q4 advance-GDP release (late January of the following year).

measures.quantity: whether a technical recession occurs within the covered window — the listed rule resolves Yes on two consecutive quarters of negative real GDP growth per BEA estimates; the series ticker says 'NBER' but settlement is the BEA two-quarter rule, not an NBER committee call
measures.reference: two consecutive negative real-GDP quarters within 2026: 2025Q1–2026Q4; 2027: 2026Q4–2027Q4
measures.source_release: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis — quarterly real GDP (advance estimates)
measures.resolution: closes at the sooner of occurrence or 8:25 AM ET on the expected release of the covered window's final Q4 advance-GDP estimate
measures.text: whether a technical recession occurs within the covered window — the listed rule resolves Yes on two consecutive quarters of negative real GDP growth per BEA estimates; the series ticker says 'NBER' but settlement is the BEA two-quarter rule, not an NBER committee call Reference: two consecutive negative real-GDP quarters within 2026: 2025Q1–2026Q4; 2027: 2026Q4–2027Q4. Source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis — quarterly real GDP (advance estimates). Resolution: closes at the sooner of occurrence or 8:25 AM ET on the expected release of the covered window's final Q4 advance-GDP estimate.

indicators.paper: Listed in the paper’s Table 1 as a Kalshi macro series; the paper’s calibration analysis finds the implied probability densities fairly well calibrated.

statuses.note: Exchange rule: two consecutive negative real-GDP quarters (BEA) within 2025Q1–2026Q4. Not occurred in the published estimates so far.
Exchange rule: two consecutive negative real-GDP quarters (BEA) within 2026Q4–2027Q4. Not occurred in the published estimates so far.

recession_realized.note: Realized overlay applies the exchange's own rule (two consecutive negative BEA quarters within the covered window — not NBER committee calls). GDP growth is the latest published estimate; flagged quarters are shaded where they fall in range.

accuracy.convention: Prediction: the Yes price at the market's final close. Scored by absolute error and Brier vs the exchange-rule outcome — two consecutive negative BEA quarters within the covered window, not an NBER committee call — as published at settlement. Resolves at final settlement (late January of the following year); pending until then.

indicators.title: IPO pipeline
indicators.why: A market-implied ECM pipeline gauge: the expected number of IPOs this year among the companies the exchange lists, plus the front-runners by announcement probability.
indicators.source: Kalshi public API v2 — series KXIPO
indicators.note: Each of the named company markets pays $1 if that company confirms an IPO before Jan 1, 2027 — confirmed means the SEC declares its Form S-1 effective, the IPO is priced, or an exchange assigns it a ticker (trading may start later). The window is calendar 2026; trading closes 11:59 PM ET on Dec 31, 2026. The expected count is the sum of the named companies' Yes prices, with already-confirmed companies counted at 1.0 each. The candidate set changes as companies are added or removed, so the count is a pipeline read, not a forecast.

measures.quantity: how many of the named companies will confirm an IPO in calendar 2026 — expected count = the sum of the Yes prices across all listed companies (settled-Yes companies contribute 1.0 each)

measures.source_release: the exchange's own settlement of the constituent company markets (an IPO is confirmed on S-1 effectiveness, pricing, or ticker assignment)
measures.resolution: each company market settles the moment its IPO is confirmed; the event's last trading day is Dec 31, 2026 (11:59 PM ET) with final settlement in early January 2027 — expected 2026-12-31

Source: the exchange's own settlement of the constituent company markets (an IPO is confirmed on S-1 effectiveness, pricing, or ticker assignment). Resolution: each company market settles the moment its IPO is confirmed; the event's last trading day is Dec 31, 2026 (11:59 PM ET) with final settlement in early January 2027 — expected 2026-12-31.

indicators.paper: Equity-market expectations sit outside the paper's macro scope; included here as the exchange's closest proxy for investment-banking ECM activity.

realized_ipo.note: 28 named companies. Confirmed so far: Shein. Count updates as the exchange settles company markets; the event itself trades through Dec 31, 2026 11:59 PM ET.

accuracy.convention: Prediction: the expected count (sum of company Yes prices, already-confirmed companies at 1.0) at the last close before the event's final trading day. Scored by absolute error vs the exchange-confirmed count at settlement. The event trades through Dec 31 and settles in early January; pending until then.

indicators.title: Macro tail risks
indicators.why: Priced tail risk at a glance: the market-implied probability of high inflation prints and weak growth quarters, summed from the CPI and GDP strike ladders each day.
indicators.source: Derived from the CPI YoY and GDP series above (Kalshi public API v2)
indicators.note: Each series is the probability the outcome clears its threshold, read off the day's strike ladder. Marginal densities only: no joint probability of high inflation AND weak growth is measurable from these markets.
indicators.paper: Follows Figure 13 of the paper, which plots the same tail-risk time series; the paper stresses these are marginal densities.

measures.quantity: marginal tail probabilities summed from the CPI and GDP strike ladders: P(CPI YoY > 3%), P(CPI YoY > 4%), P(real GDP growth < 1.5%), P(real GDP growth < 0%)
measures.reference: CPI tails price November 2026; GDP tails price 2026Q3
measures.source_release: same releases as the CPI and GDP series (BLS CPI; BEA advance GDP estimate)
measures.resolution: inherits the underlying CPI and GDP events' resolution days
measures.text: marginal tail probabilities summed from the CPI and GDP strike ladders: P(CPI YoY > 3%), P(CPI YoY > 4%), P(real GDP growth < 1.5%), P(real GDP growth < 0%) Reference: CPI tails price November 2026; GDP tails price 2026Q3. Source: same releases as the CPI and GDP series (BLS CPI; BEA advance GDP estimate). Resolution: inherits the underlying CPI and GDP events' resolution days.

accuracy.note: Per resolved event: the market's forecast at a fixed, documented lead time vs the realized outcome — the day-before close for FOMC meetings (the statement lands mid-session), the final pre-release close for morning data releases, the final close for annual events. Records are append-only: predictions freeze at first record and each daily run only adds newly resolved events and fills outcomes still pending. Nothing resolved yet reads as pending, never as 0/0.
